name: Northeast 115
description: The Northeast 115 peak-bagging list and Aaron's ascent notes.

ascents.note: Matt Hahn and I followed Lucy Hopkins and Neil Shaffer's La Vida group for pictures! We full-packed while the group day-hiked, and they FLEW, so it was a challenge to keep up. Other than the sawflies at the summit, it was beautiful, espeically once the fog cleared up. I remember a series of cairns near the peak and the excitment from the group as they chased each new one!
The first time, Abi and Lila from S1 M1 with Phebe slid down the water and hit a rock (SCARY!), but they remained mostly unscathed. A gloomy hike, unfortunately, but

The second time through (S3 M1 with Anna Siebert) was a MUCH nicer view. Still foggy on the morning hike up, but the sky cleared and the sun came out so that you could see Noonmark and Giant from the big slide on the way up!
Almost bushpushed this one to the summit (M3 with Natasha), which turned pretty disastrous, but it was redeemed during S3 M3 with Anna Siebert.
This was the last peak along the ridge starting from Lincoln Gap, including Mt. Abraham. Honestly not that great of a view – there's just a ski lift at the top. A fun challenge nonetheless!
My "first" hike! Caleb Fecher and Ethan Beam took me with them as a guys' trip, which ended up sparking alove for hiking I hadn't imagined I'd grow to have!
Second time hiking it was after my first summer on Base Camp for La Vida – Caedmon and I hiked it at sunrise for the most gorgeous pano shots I've ever taken!
First time hiking this mountain, it was SO dreary! T

The second time hiking this was M1 with Anna Siebert – the group debated giving up because fo the sudden rain, but they said a prayer for the skies to open up, and the fog burned off as we summitted for a stunning view!

Quite a rocky trail! The ridge hike starting at Lincoln Gap passed Abraham and continue to Mt. Ellen. Abraham was definitely the better of the two, and the summit is gorgeous! Even saw a rabbit (though I'm not sure it was alive...)
